name: ai-panel-actions-fit-one-line
description: the AI panel's two quick actions are glyph squares and the language picker shows a code, so all three sit on one line. Reads the row's children off the /ai-panel document, hovers a glyph to raise the shared hint bubble carrying the label the button no longer prints, and captures the open panel for a visual check.

actions.note: the container widens before the card's own layout settles

actions.expression: (() => { const kids = [...document.querySelector('.aiquick').children]; const tops = new Set(kids.map((k) => Math.round(k.getBoundingClientRect().top))); return kids.length + '/' + tops.size; })()
actions.note: three children sharing one top offset is the whole claim: a wrapped picker lands on a second one

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-ai-panel-quick="bullets"]'); b.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerover', {bubbles: true})); return 'sent'; })()

actions.note: the hover hint's own 600ms delay, on the real clock

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-ai-panel-quick="bullets"]').getBoundingClientRect(); const h = document.querySelector('.hint').getBoundingClientRect(); return h.bottom <= b.top ? 'above' : 'below'; })()
actions.note: the action row is one button-height off the bottom, so a bubble placed below lands on the prompt field
the first stream in a run can deliver no frames

assertions.desc: setup: the hotkey opened the panel
the two actions and the picker share one row
the buttons print no label and the picker prints codes
the hover hint carries the label the glyph dropped
the bubble clears the prompt field instead of sitting on it
